funds_data.description: The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) and seeks to achieve its objective by (1) investing in a diversified portfolio of higher-yielding high quality short-term money market instruments and/or money market mutual funds and (2) investing in ultra-short-term options strategies that seek to generate current income.
